text: the bus is catching not everything. infact for the world builder it only is catching the literal build pieces and none of t he terrain/tile/water/flora painting tools
resolution: Wired the native world-builder paint path into the editor event bus instead of only watching React-side build-piece placement. The map engine now records completed terrain, tile, water, flora, zone, road, chunk, zone-drop, and tile-binding authoring events; the V8 binding exposes a drain door; the runtime decodes typed events; AppFrame enriches them with editor catalog labels, coordinates, brush stats, material names, and timing; and Eventbus Review renders those map.paint rows directly.
